children.game_version: The 'Floss-Off' challenge: who can keep the rhythm longest.

seniors.seated_version: Perform arm swings while seated, focusing on shoulder range of motion.
seniors.standing_version: Perform arm swings with feet planted firmly to ensure balance.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce speed significantly; focus on fluid arm movement rather than rapid swings.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Parallel alternating arm swings with clenched fists.
movement_profile.posture: Starr geradeaus gerichteter Blick (staring straight ahead).

signature_moves.description: Two swings in front of the body, one swing behind the body.
signature_moves.name: The Floss

basic_steps: Swing arms from back to front on alternating sides.
Perform two swings in front of the body.
Perform one swing behind the body.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high speed and coordination of arms and hips.
